# FishboneDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasFishboneDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasFishboneDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasFishboneDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasFishboneDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

Cause and effect (Ishikawa / fishbone)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasFishboneDiagram> CreateFishboneDiagramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasFishboneDiagram> CreateFishboneDiagramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, FishboneDesign design);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasFishboneDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

| `onCategorySelect` | `std::function<void(size_t, const FishboneCategory&)> onCategorySelect` | _Category select_ |

| `onCauseHover` | `std::function<void(const FishboneRef&, const FishboneCause&)> onCauseHover` | _Cause hover_ |
| `onCauseDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(const FishboneRef&, const FishboneCause&)> onCauseDoubleClick` | _Cause double click_ |
| `onSelectionChange` | `std::function<void()> onSelectionChange` | _Selection change_ |

## Option types in this header

### enum `FishboneDesign`

Geometry presets. Every design draws the same document; they differ in how the spine is drawn, how ribs meet it and where the causes sit.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Classic` | Textbook herringbone: thin spine, straight angled ribs, |
| `SpineChips` | category boxes at the rib tips, causes on the twigs Solid tapered spine arrow, category pills on the spine |
| `CrossedRibs` | ending in circular icon badges, dot-terminated twigs One full-length rib per pair of categories, crossing the |
| `Bracket` | spine; chips at both outer ends, bullet cause blocks Parallelogram bones (slanted edge + shelf) with |
| `ChevronSpine` | horizontal dot leaders and chips at the outer corner Spine as a chain of chevron blocks; hairline leaders to |
| `Columns` | floating pills, each with its own bullet list Rib-less: a tinted panel per category straddling the |
| `Vertical` | spine, icon badge at the far end, bullet list inside Classic rotated: spine top to bottom, ribs left/right |
| `Compact` | All categories on one side of a low spine |

### enum `FishboneSidePolicy`

Which side of the spine a category's rib leaves from. "Above" means left for the Vertical design, "Below" means right.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Alternate` | Category 0 above, 1 below, 2 above, ... (the default) |
| `AllAbove` |  |
| `AllBelow` |  |
| `PerCategory` | Use FishboneCategory::side (0 falls back to Alternate) |

### enum `FishboneHeadShape`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Arrow` | Stroked arrowhead on the spine |
| `Triangle` | Large filled triangle (the infographic head) |
| `Box` | Rounded box holding the effect text |
| `FishHead` | Rounded fish head with an eye |
| `Hidden` |  |

### enum `FishboneTailShape`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Hidden` |  |
| `Chevron` | A single chevron notch |
| `Triangle` | Filled triangle |
| `FishTail` | Two-lobed decorative tail |

### enum `FishboneEffectPlacement`

Where the effect text goes. All five reference designs surveyed put it in the title and leave the head decorative, so Title is the default.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Title` | Drawn as the element title above the diagram |
| `HeadBox` | Drawn inside a box at the head of the spine |
| `Hidden` |  |

### enum `FishboneCauseMarker`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Dot` | Filled circle at the twig end |
| `Bullet` | Small bullet before the text |
| `Numbered` | 1. 2. 3. before the text |
| `Hidden` |  |

### enum `FishboneLabelPlacement`

Where a category's name is drawn. Designs pick a sensible default; this overrides it.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Auto` |  |
| `RibTip` | Chip at the outer end of the rib |
| `OnSpine` | Pill sitting on the spine at the rib root |
| `BesideSpine` | Plain text next to the spine |
| `PanelHeader` | Header inside the category panel (Columns) |

### enum `FishbonePalette`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `CorporateBlue` |  |
| `Vibrant` |  |
| `Pastel` |  |
| `Ocean` |  |
| `Sunset` |  |
| `Forest` |  |
| `Slate` |  |
| `Mono` |  |
| `Custom` | Use the colors passed to SetCustomPalette() |

### struct `FishboneRef`

Identifies one drawn thing: a category (cause < 0), a cause (subCause < 0) or a sub-cause.

| `category` | `int category = -1` |  |
| `cause` | `int cause = -1` |  |
| `subCause` | `int subCause = -1` |  |

Methods: `IsValid`, `IsCategory`, `IsCause`, `IsSubCause`
